Kuphela okuqukethwe okudingekayo ekusebenzeni okuthile okukucelayo okudluliswayo.

sections.h: 10. Ubuhlakani Bokwenziwa kanye Nomthethonqubo (EU) 2024/1689 (Umthetho we-EU AI)
sections.b:
10.1. I-Platform ihlanganisa amamodeli e-AI ajwayelekile atholakala esidlangalaleni abahlinzeki bezinkampani zangaphandle nge-API yabo esemthethweni (i-Google Gemini, i-Anthropic Claude, i-OpenAI, i-HeyGen, i-ElevenLabs, i-FAL.ai) ukuze kuhlaziywe izitayela, kukhiqizwe imibhalo namagama angukhiye, kuhunyushwe, kuhlaziywe ividiyo ngohlaka ngohlaka, kukhishwe ama-avatar kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwenkulumo. Umhlinzeki akathuthukisi noma aqeqeshe amamodeli akhe e-AI futhi akuyena umhlinzeki wamamodeli e-AI ajwayelekile ngaphakathi kwencazelo yoMthethonqubo (EU) 2024/1689 ("Umthetho we-EU AI").

10.2. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ye-Platform kuwela ezigabeni zobungozi obuncane kanye nobungozi obulinganiselwe boMthetho we-EU AI. I-Platform ayisebenzisi izinhlelo ze-AI ezinobungozi obukhulu ngaphakathi kwencazelo yeSijobelelo III soMthethonqubo.

10.3. Ukucaca kokuqukethwe okwenziwe: i-Platform iyithuluzi lokudala ividiyo, umsindo nezithombe ezikhiqizwe yi-AI nezishintshwe yi-AI (kuhlanganise nama-avatar namazwi akopishiwe). Izici ze-AI zibhalwe ngokucacile kusixhumi esibonakalayo. Lapho abahlinzeki be-AI abangaphansi befaka izimpawu ezifundeka ngomshini noma ama-watermark kokuqukethwe okukhiqiziwe (Isihloko 50(2) soMthetho we-EU AI), i-Platform iyawagcina futhi ayiwakhiphi. Abasebenzisi baboshelwe ngokwenkontileka ukudalula ama-deep fake nokunye okuqukethwe okwenziwe njengoba kudingwa yiSihloko 50(4) soMthetho we-EU AI kanye nemithetho yamanethiwekhi omphakathi lapho beshicilela khona (bona Imigomo Yesevisi).

10.4. Izenzo ezingavunyelwe yiSihloko 5 soMthetho we-EU AI — ukukhohlisa okungabonakali, ukuxhaphaza ubungozi (kuhlanganise nobezingane), ukuhlela amaphuzu omphakathi, ukuhlolwa kokubikezela ubugebengu babantu, ukuklwebha okungahlosiwe kwezithombe zobuso ku-inthanethi noma ku-CCTV, ukuqashelwa kwemizwa emsebenzini nasezemfundo, ukuhlukaniswa kwe-biometric okusekelwe ezicini ezibucayi, kanye nokuhlonza kwe-biometric okukude ngesikhathi sangempela ezindaweni ezifinyeleleka esidlangalaleni — azinikezwa yi-Platform, azivunyelwe yiMigomo Yesevisi, futhi izicelo ezihlose lezo zenzo ziyenqatshwa.

10.5. Ukuqondiswa ngumuntu: Imiphumela ye-AI (ukuhlaziya, imibhalo, amagama angukhiye, amavidiyo akhiqiziwe) ingamapulani angase aqukathe ukungalungi. Abasebenzisi babuyekeza futhi bagunyaze okuqukethwe ngaphambi kokusetshenziswa noma ukushicilelwa.

I-Platform iyithuluzi lobuchwepheshe elihloselwe abantu abaneminyaka okungenani engu-18. Umhlinzeki akaqoqi ngamabomu idatha yomuntu siqu yezingane. Uma ukholwa ukuthi ingane inikeze i-Platform idatha yomuntu siqu, sicela uxhumane SEO@trendtraffic.pro futhi idatha izosuswa.

Umhlinzeki angase achibiyele le Nqubomgomo, ikakhulukazi ukuze abonise izinguquko emthethweni noma ekusebenzeni kwe-Platform. Inguqulo yamanje ihlale ishicilelwe ku-Platform, enosuku "lokugcina olubuyekeziwe" phezulu. Esimeni sezinguquko ezibalulekile, Abasebenzisi bazokwaziswa ngaphezu kwalokho nge-imeyili noma kuhlelo lokusebenza.

4.3. Isivivinyo singakhanselwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngaphambi kokuphela kwaso, mahhala, kuzilungiselelo zokukhokha.

4.4. Isivivinyo samahhala sitholakala kanye kumsebenzisi ngamunye. Umhlinzeki angase enqabe noma ahoxise izivivinyo uma kukhona ukuhlukumeza (isb. ukubhalisa okuphindaphindiwe).

5.1. Ukuqhubeka nokusebenzisa Ipulatifomu ngemuva kwesivivinyo kudinga ukubhalisa okukhokhelwayo (isb. I-Premium — €49 ngenyanga). Intengo yamanje, kuhlanganise nezintela ezisebenzayo, iboniswa ekhasini lokukhokha ngesikhathi sokwenziwa komsebenzi.

5.2. Izinkokhelo zicutshungulwa umhlinzeki wezokukhokha i-Stripe. Umhlinzeki akagcini imininingwane ephelele yekhadi lokukhokha.

5.3. Ukubhalisa kuvuselela ngokuzenzakalelayo izikhathi ezilandelanayo zanyanga zonke kuze kukhanselwe. Ungakhansela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kuzilungiselelo zokukhokha; ukukhansela kuqala ukusebenza ekupheleni kwesikhathi esikhokhelwayo samanje, futhi uhlala unokufinyelela kuze kube yileso sikhathi.

5.4. Umhlinzeki angashintsha izintengo zokubhalisa. Izinguquko zamanani zimemezelwa okungenani izinsuku eziyi-14 kusengaphambili futhi zisebenza kuphela kusukela esikhathini esilandelayo sokukhokha; uma ungavumelani, ungakhansela ngaphambi kokuba intengo entsha iqale ukusebenza.

5.5. Izindleko zezinkampani zangaphandle azifakiwe ekubhaliseni: izimali zokhiye be-API bomsebenzisi kanye nokubhaliselwa (isb. Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, FAL.ai, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Blotato, TikHub), amakhomishini abahlinzeki bezinkokhelo kanye namanani ezinkundla zokuxhumana akhokhwa Umsebenzisi ngqo kubahlinzeki abafanele ngaphansi kwemibandela yabo.

sections.h: 6. Inqubomgomo Yokungabuyisi Imali kanye Nelungelo Lokuhoxisa
sections.b:
6.1. Ipulatifomu inikeza ukufinyelela okugcwele kokuqukethwe kwedijithali kanye nezinsiza zokubala (kuhlanganise nezindleko zokucubungula izicelo ze-AI) ngokushesha lapho inkokhelo iphumelele.

6.2. Abathengi e-EU — ukuyeka ilungelo lokuhoxisa: ngokuhambisana ne-Directive 2011/83/EU kanye ne-Polish Act yangoMeyi 30, 2014 mayelana namaLungelo Abathengi (ikakhulukazi izinhlinzeko mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kokuqukethwe kwedijithali nezinsizakalo zedijithali), ngokwenza kusebenze ukubhalisa okukhokhelwayo umthengi ucela ngokusobala futhi uyavuma ukuthi ukusebenza kuqale ngokushesha, ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi sokuhoxisa esijwayelekile sezinsuku eziyi-14, futhi uyavuma ukuthi ngalokho ulahlekelwa ilungelo lokuhoxisa kusukela ngesikhathi isevisi yenziwa itholakale ngokugcwele. Lokhu kuvuma nokuvuma kuqoqwa ngaphezu kwalokho lapho kukhokhwa.

6.3. Ngokufanele, izinkokhelo ziyisiphetho futhi azibuyiswa, kuhlanganise nalapho Umsebenzisi ekhansela ukubhalisa ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi sokukhokha (ukufinyelela kuyaqhubeka kuze kube sekupheleni kwaleso sikhathi). Isivivinyo samahhala sezinsuku eziyi-7 (Isigaba 4) sinikezwa ngqo ukuze isevisi ihlolwe ngokugcwele ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe noma iyiphi inkokhelo.

6.4. Izigatshana 6.1–6.3 azikhiphi noma azikhawuleli noma yimaphi amalungelo umthetho oyimpoqo awanikeza abathengi futhi angenakuyekwa, kuhlanganise namakhambi asemthethweni okungahambisani kokuqukethwe kwedijithali nezinsizakalo zedijithali (Directive (EU) 2019/770 kanye nokuqaliswa kwayo kwe-Polish). Lapho lezi zinhlinzeko eziyimpoqo zisebenza, zidlula lesi Sigaba.

6.5. Kubasebenzisi abangewona abathengi (abasebenzisi bebhizinisi), zonke izimali ziyisiphetho futhi azibuyiswa ngokugcwele ngendlela evunyelwe umthetho.

sections.h: 7. Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-BYOK, i-Chrome Extension kanye ne-MCP
sections.b:
7.1. I-Platform ivumela Umsebenzisi ukuthi axhume okwakhe okhiye be-API kanye nokubhaliselwe kwezinsizakalo zezinkampani zangaphandle ("BYOK") — isibonelo i-Google Gemini, i-Anthropic Claude, i-OpenAI, i-FAL.ai, i-ElevenLabs, i-HeyGen, i-Blotato noma i-TikHub. Lezi zinsizakalo zisetshenziswa ngaphansi kwezivumelwano zoMsebenzisi nabahlinzeki abafanele; Umsebenzisi uthwala izindleko ezihambisanayo futhi unesibopho sokuthobela imigomo yabahlinzeki.

7.2. I-TrendTraffic Chrome extension ixhuma izici ezithile (isb. i-HeyGen, i-Google Flow, i-NotebookLM) ngama-akhawunti akhe kanye nokubhaliselwe koMsebenzisi kusiphequluli sakhe. Umsebenzisi unesibopho sokusebenzisa lawo ma-akhawunti ngokuhambisana nemigomo yezinsizakalo ezifanele; uMhlinzeki akaqinisekisi ukuhambisana okungaphazamiseki kwe-extension nezixhumanisi zezinkampani zangaphandle futhi angase abuyekeze noma ayeke izixhumi ngazinye uma inkampani yangaphandle ishintsha imithetho noma ubuchwepheshe bayo.

7.3. Okhiye be-API abahlinzekwe uMsebenzisi bagcinwa befihliwe futhi basetshenziswa kuphela ukwenza imisebenzi eceliwe uMsebenzisi. Umsebenzisi angabakhipha noma nini kuzilungiselelo.

7.4. Ukhiye we-MCP womuntu siqu uvumela abasizi be-AI (isb. i-Claude) ukuthi bafinyelele i-akhawunti yoMsebenzisi. Umsebenzisi unesibopho sokugcina ukhiye uyimfihlo kanye nayo yonke imisebenzi eyenziwe ngawo, futhi angawuhoxisa noma nini.

8.1. Umsebenzisi uzibophezela ukuthi ngeke asebenzise i-Platform ngenhloso yokwenza:

  • noma yimuphi umsebenzi ongekho emthethweni, ugaxekile, ukukhwabanisa noma yiluphi uhlobo lokukhwabanisa;
  • ukudala, ukuhlaziya noma ukusabalalisa okuqukethwe okungekho emthethweni, okuhlambalazayo, okuhlukumezayo, noma okuphula amalungelo empahla yobuhlakani, ubumfihlo noma amalungelo okushicilela ezinkampani zangaphandle;
  • ukudala noma ukusebenzisa isithombe noma izwi lomuntu wangempela ngaphandle kwamalungelo adingekayo noma imvume yalowo muntu, kuhlanganise nokuzenza abantu bangempela;
  • ukudala okuqukethwe okucansi, okusondelene noma okuhlukumezayo okubonisa abantu bangempela ababonakalayo ngaphandle kwemvume yabo ecacile, noma noma yikuphi okuqukethwe okunjalo okubandakanya abancane (okungavunyelwe ngokuphelele futhi kuzobikwa kuziphathimandla ezifanele);
  • ukudala okuqukethwe okukhohlisayo okuhloswe ukudukisa umphakathi, kuhlanganise nokungaqiniseki mayelana nokhetho, impilo yomphakathi noma ukuphepha;
  • ukuphula imigomo yesevisi yezinkampani zangaphandle ezihlanganisiwe (ikakhulukazi i-TikTok, i-Meta/Instagram, i-YouTube/Google, i-HeyGen, i-ElevenLabs, i-Blotato, i-Stripe), kuhlanganise nemithetho yazo mayelana nemidiya yokwenziwa nokushicilela okuzenzakalelayo;
  • ukuzama ukuphazamisa, ukulayisha ngokweqile, ukubuyisela emuva noma ukuthola ukufinyelela okungagunyaziwe ku-Platform;
  • ukusebenzisa izici ze-AI ngokuphambene ne-Athikili 5 ye-Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act), kuhlanganise nokwenza: ukukhohlisa okungabonakali; ukuxhaphaza ubungozi bezingane noma amaqembu asengozini; ukuhlola umphakathi; ukuhlolwa kokubikezela ubugebengu babantu; ukuklwebha okungahlosiwe kwezithombe zobuso ku-inthanethi noma ku-CCTV; ukuqashelwa kwemizwa yabasebenzi noma abafundi; ukuhlukaniswa kwe-biometric okusekelwe ezicini ezibucayi; noma ukuhlonza i-biometric yesikhathi sangempela ezindaweni ezifinyeleleka emphakathini.

8.2. Ngokulayisha isithombe noma ukuqoshwa kwezwi, Umsebenzisi umemezela futhi uqinisekisa ukuthi ungumuntu obonisiwe/oqoshiwe noma uphethe imvume ecacile, enolwazi yalowo muntu (futhi, ngezinto ezingaphansi kwe-copyright, amalayisense adingekayo).

8.3. Uma kwenzeka kuphulwa umthetho, uMhlinzeki angase akhiphe okuqukethwe okonayo futhi amise noma aqede i-akhawunti yoMsebenzisi ngaphandle kokubuyiselwa imali (Isigaba 13), ngaphandle kokulimaza amanye amakhambi asemthethweni.

sections.h: 9. Izici ze-AI, Okuqukethwe Okwenziwe kanye Nokungafihli
sections.b:
9.1. Izici ze-AI ze-Platform zisebenza kumamodeli ajwayelekile atholakala emphakathini abahlinzeki bezinkampani zangaphandle (i-Google Gemini, i-Anthropic Claude, i-OpenAI, i-HeyGen, i-ElevenLabs, i-FAL.ai) abizwa nge-API esemthethweni. Imininingwane yokucutshungulwa kwedatha ibekwe ku-Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo.

9.2. Okuqukethwe okwenziwe yi-AI (ukuhlaziya, izikripthi, amagama angukhiye, amazwi, amavidiyo) kungase kube namaphutha noma ukungalungi futhi akukhohlisi iseluleko sochwepheshe, olusemthethweni, lwezokwelapha noma lwezezimali. Umsebenzisi kufanele abuyekeze okuqukethwe okwenziwe ngaphambi kokusetshenziswa noma ukushicilelwa futhi uthwala isibopho esigcwele sokusetshenziswa kwakho.

9.3. Ukwembulwa kokuqukethwe okwenziwe: lapho Umsebenzisi ekhiqiza noma elawula isithombe, umsindo noma okuqukethwe kwevidiyo okufana kakhulu nabantu abakhona, izinto, izindawo noma imicimbi futhi kungase kubonakale kumuntu njengokwangempela noma okuyiqiniso (i-"deep fake"), Umsebenzisi kufanele embule ngokucacile nangokuhlukile ukuthi okuqukethwe kuye kwakhiqizwa noma kwalawulwa ngokwenziwa, ngokuhambisana ne-Athikili 50(4) ye-EU AI Act kanye nemithetho yamanethiwekhi omphakathi lapho okuqukethwe kushicilelwa khona. Lapho abahlinzeki be-AI bezinkampani zangaphandle befaka izimpawu ezifundeka ngomshini noma ama-watermark kokuqukethwe okwenziwe, Umsebenzisi akufanele akukhiphe noma akufihle.

9.4. UMhlinzeki akaqinisekisi ukuthi okuqukethwe okwenziwe yi-AI akunamalungelo ezinkampani zangaphandle (isb. lapho okufakwe uMsebenzisi kuqukethe izinto ezivikelwe) futhi akaqinisekisi noma yimuphi umphumela othile wezentengiselwano (ukubukwa, ukufinyelela, ukwenza imali).

10.1. Umsebenzisi ugcina wonke amalungelo ezintweni azilayishayo. Umsebenzisi unikeza uMhlinzeki ilayisense elingelona elikhethekile, lomhlaba wonke lokusingatha, ukugcina, ukucubungula, ukulungisa nokudlulisa lezo zinto kuphela ngendlela edingekayo ukuze kunikezwe izinsizakalo zePlatifomu (kuhlanganise nokudluliselwa kubahlinzeki be-AI namanethiwekhi omphakathi akhethwe uMsebenzisi). Ilayisense liphela lapho okuqukethwe noma i-akhawunti isuswa, ngaphandle kwamakhophi adingwa umthetho.

10.2. Phakathi koMhlinzeki noMsebenzisi, uMhlinzeki akasho amalungelo emiphumeleni ekhiqizelwe uMsebenzisi. Amalungelo oMsebenzisi emiphumeleni ekhiqizwe yi-AI anqunywa umthetho osebenzayo kanye nemigomo yabahlinzeki be-AI abathathu ababandakanyekayo; uMsebenzisi unesibopho sokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwakhe okuhlosiwe kuvunyelwe.

10.3. Isoftware yePlatifomu, idizayini, izimpawu zokuhweba kanye nemininingwane egciniwe kuhlala kuyimpahla yoMhlinzeki noma abanikazi bamalayisense akhe. Le Migomo ayinikezi amalungelo kubo ngaphezu kwelungelo lokusebenzisa iPlatifomu njengoba kuhloswe.

10.4. Okuqukethwe okungokwesithathu okuboniswe ekuhlaziyweni kwezindlela (amavidiyo, izembozo, izilinganiso zeTikTok/Instagram/YouTube) kuhlala kuyimpahla yabanikazi bamalungelo namapulatifomu afanele; kuboniswa ukuze kuhlaziywe imakethe. Noma yikuphi ukusetshenziswa okuqhubekayo kwalokho okuqukethwe uMsebenzisi (isb. ukulayisha kabusha ividiyo yomunye umuntu) kudinga isisekelo somthetho somsebenzisi uqobo.

11.1. Ukucubungula idatha yomuntu siqu yabasebenzisi kuchazwe ku-Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo.

11.2. Lapho izinto ezilayishwa noma ezicubungulwa uMsebenzisi kuPlatifomu ziqukethe idatha yomuntu siqu yabantu besithathu (ngokwesibonelo, isithombe noma izwi lomethuli, izibuyekezo zamakhasimende), uMsebenzisi usebenza njengoMlawuli Wedatha yaleyo datha futhi uMhlinzeki uyicubungula njengoMhlinzeki ngaphakathi kwencazelo ye-Article 28 GDPR — kuphela ngemiyalelo ebhaliwe yoMsebenzisi evezwe ngokusetshenziswa kwezici zePlatifomu, futhi kuphela ukuze kunikezwe insizakalo.

11.3. UMhlinzeki usebenzisa izinyathelo zokuphepha ezifanele zobuchwepheshe nezokuhlela, usebenzisa kuphela abacubunguli abancane ababalwe ku-Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo (uMsebenzisi uyavuma ukusetshenziswa kwabo; izinguquko ezibalulekile zizomenyezelwa), usiza uMsebenzisi ngokufanele ngezicelo zesihloko sedatha, futhi ususa noma ubuyisa idatha ekupheleni kwensizakalo ngokuhambisana nemithetho yokugcina yeNqubomgomo Yobumfihlo.

12.1. "Njengoba kunjalo": iPlatifomu inikezwa "njengoba kunjalo" futhi "njengoba itholakala". Ngokwezinga elivunyelwe umthetho, uMhlinzeki akaqinisekisi ukuthi iPlatifomu izosebenza ngaphandle kweziphazamiso noma amaphutha noma ukuthi izohlangabezana nezilindelo ezithile zoMsebenzisi.

12.2. Ukuncika kwabantu besithathu: ukusebenza kwePlatifomu kuncike kakhulu kubahlinzeki besithathu. UMhlinzeki akabophezeleki ngalokhu: ukuphazamiseka, izinguquko emithethweni noma imikhawulo yama-API nezinsizakalo zeTikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google, TikHub, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Google (Gemini, Flow, NotebookLM), Anthropic, OpenAI, FAL.ai, Blotato noma Stripe; ngezinqumo zokulinganisa zamanethiwekhi omphakathi mayelana nokuqukethwe okushicilelwe uMsebenzisi; noma ngezinkinga ezibangelwa abahlinzeki bokusingatha.

12.3. Ngokwezinga elivunyelwe umthetho, uMhlinzeki akabophezeleki ngomonakalo ongaqondile, inzuzo elahlekile, ukulahlekelwa idatha noma ukulahlekelwa amakhasimende okubangelwa ukusetshenziswa, noma ukungakwazi ukusebenzisa, iPlatifomu.

12.4. Isibopho esiphezulu esihlanganisiwe soMhlinzeki kuMsebenzisi ngazo zonke izimangalo sikhawulelwe enanini elikhokhelwe uMsebenzisi ngezinsizakalo zePlatifomu enyangeni yekhalenda edlule ngaphambi kwesigameko esibangele isimangalo.

12.5. Imikhawulo kulesi Sigaba ayisebenzi esibophweni sokuziphatha okungahlosiwe noma ubudedengu obukhulu, ngokufa noma ukulimala komuntu siqu, noma kunoma yiziphi ezinye izimo lapho isibopho singenakukhawulelwa ngaphansi komthetho oyisibopho. Kubathengi, amakhambi asemthethweni okungahambisani kwezinsizakalo zedijithali ahlala engathinteki (Isigaba 6.4).

13.1. Umsebenzisi angayeka ukusebenzisa iPlatifomu futhi asuse i-akhawunti nganoma yisiphi isikhathi; Isigaba 6 sisebenza ezinkokhelweni esezikhokhiwe.

13.2. UMhlinzeki angamisa noma aqede i-akhawunti, asuse okuqukethwe futhi enqabe insizakalo — ngaphandle kokubuyiselwa kwemali eseyikhokhiwe — uma kwenzeka ukwephulwa okukhulu kwale Migomo (ikakhulukazi Isigaba 8), lapho kudingwa umthetho noma umyalelo wesiphathimandla esinekhono, noma uma kwenzeka usongo olukhulu lokuphepha. Lapho kufaneleka, uMhlinzeki uzoqala ngokukhipha isixwayiso futhi abeke umnqamulajuqu wokulungisa ukwephulwa; esimweni sabathengi, amalungelo asemthethweni mayelana nezikhathi ezikhokhelwe ahlala engathinteki lapho ukuqedwa kungabangelwa ukwephulwa komthengi.

13.3. Izigaba 6, 10, 12 kanye no-15 zihlala zisebenza ngemuva kokuqedwa.

14.1. UMhlinzeki angachibiyela le Migomo ngezizathu ezifanele: izinguquko emthethweni, izici ezintsha, izidingo zokuphepha noma izinguquko ezinsizakalweni ezihlanganisiwe zabantu besithathu.

14.2. Abasebenzisi bazokwaziswa ngezichibiyelo ezibalulekile okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ngaphambi kokuba ziqale ukusebenza, nge-imeyili noma kuhlelo lokusebenza. Uma uMsebenzisi engavumi, angakwazi ukuqeda ukubhalisa ngaphambi kokuba izichibiyelo ziqale ukusebenza; ukuqhubeka nokusebenzisa ngemuva kwalolo suku kubonisa ukwamukela.

15.1. Le Migomo ilawulwa yimithetho yeRiphabhulikhi yasePoland. Uma Umsebenzisi engumthengi, lokhu kukhethwa komthetho akumbandakanyi ekuvikelweni okunikezwa yizinhlinzeko eziyimpoqo zomthetho wendawo yakhe yokuhlala ejwayelekile (Isigaba 6(2) soMthethonqubo (EC) No 593/2008, "Rome I").

15.2. Kubasebenzisi bebhizinisi, izingxabano zingaphansi kwegunya elikhethekile lenkantolo efanele yehhovisi elibhalisiwe loMhlinzeki (Warsaw, Poland). Kubathengi, igunya linqunywa yimithetho esebenzayo esemthethweni.

15.3. Umthengi angasebenzisa izindlela zokuxazulula izikhalazo ngaphandle kwenkantolo, isibonelo usizo lwe-Polish Trade Inspection (Inspekcja Handlowa), abameli babathengi bakamasipala noma besifunda, noma izinhlangano ze-ADR zezwe labo. (Ipulatifomu ye-EU yokuxazulula izingxabano ku-inthanethi yayimiswe ngoJulayi 2025.)

15.4. Izikhalazo zingathunyelwa ku- SEO@trendtraffic.pro; uMhlinzeki uphendula zingakapheli izinsuku eziyi-14.

cookies.title: Inqubomgomo Yamakhukhi
cookies.subtitle: yeplatifomu ye-TrendTraffic
cookies.metaDescription: Yimaphi amakhukhi nokungena kwe-localStorage i-TrendTraffic ekusebenzisayo, ngenhloso yani nangokwesikhathi esingakanani, yimaphi amaqembu esithathu abeka amakhukhi (Stripe, ukungena kwe-Google), nokuthi ungakunikeza, ukwenqabe noma ukushintshe kanjani ukuvuma kwakho.

sections.b:
1.1. Amakhukhi amafayela amancane ombhalo agcinwe kudivayisi yakho uma uvakashela iwebhusayithi, okuvumela isayithi ukuthi libone idivayisi yakho futhi likhumbule izintandokazi.

1.2. Ngaphezu kwamakhukhi, ipulatifomu ye-TrendTraffic isebenzisa i-Local Storage yesiphequluli — phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukugcina ithokheni yokugunyazwa yeseshini yakho, ulimi lwakho netimu yesixhumi esibonakalayo, kanye nokukhetha kwakho ukuvuma amakhukhi. Le Nqubomgomo isebenza kumakhukhi naku-Local Storage ngokufanayo.

2.1. Okudingeka kakhulu (okobuchwepheshe) — okudingekayo ukuze iPlatifomu isebenze; asetshenziswa ngesisekelo senzalo esemthethweni yoMhlinzeki futhi awadingi imvume:

  • vibevox_token — ithokheni yokugunyazwa ye-JWT yeseshini yakho (Local Storage; kuze kube ukuphuma noma ukuphelelwa yisikhathi kwethokheni);
  • vibevox_user — inqolobane yephrofayela yomsebenzisi ongenile (Local Storage; kuze kube ukuphuma);
  • tt_cookie_consent — igcina ukukhetha kwakho ukuvuma amakhukhi (Local Storage; kuze kube yilapho ukushintsha noma ukukusula).

2.2. Okusebenzayo (izintandokazi):

  • i18nextLng — ulimi olukhethiwe lwesixhumi esibonakalayo (Local Storage; kuze kube yilapho kushintshwa noma kusulwa);
  • vibevox_theme — itimu ekhanyayo/emnyama (Local Storage; kuze kube yilapho kushintshwa noma kusulwa).

Ngenxa yezizathu zomlando, ezinye izihlonzi zinegama elithi "vibevox" lomugqa womkhiqizo wangaphambili woMhlinzeki; zingezepulatifomu ye-TrendTraffic.

2.3. Izibalo: iPlatifomu okwamanje ayibeki izilandeleli zezibalo noma zokukhangisa ezivela eceleni. Izilinganiso zesevisi eziyisisekelo, ezivikela ubumfihlo ziqoqwa ohlangothini lweseva ngaphandle kokulandelela okuphambene namasayithi. Uma izibalo ezisekelwe emvumeni zingeniswa, zizosebenza kuphela ngemuva kokuthi ukhethe "Yamukela konke".

2.4. Amakhukhi avela eceleni: izinsizakalo zangaphandle ezihlanganiswe nePlatifomu zingabeka amakhukhi azo lapho uzisebenzisa:

  • Stripe — ukuphepha kokukhokha nokuvimbela ukukhwabanisa emakhasini okukhokha nawokukhokha (isb. __stripe_mid, ~unyaka owodwa; __stripe_sid, ~imizuzu engama-30);
  • Google — uma usebenzisa "Ngena nge-Google", i-Google ibeka amakhukhi ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo yayo;
  • Amanethiwekhi omphakathi axhunyiwe (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube) — kuphela ngaphakathi kwezixhumi zabo lapho uxhumeka noma uzivula.

• Ukuqinisekiswa nokuvikelwa kweseshini yoMsebenzisi.
  • Ukuphepha kokwenziwa kokukhokha.
